name: email_unverified_referral_claim_reply_draft
branch: Ravi Shah's brother asks for a reply to th_c06_claim_p16 where Ravi claimed Dr. Brooks waived the cardiology referral requirement; the desk checks and drafts a reply that a referral is required and none is on file
tests: the agent reads th_c06_claim_p16, verifies Ravi Shah, checks get_referral_status, and drafts a reply stating a referral is required
instruction:
You are Dev Shah, calling on behalf of your brother Ravi Shah. Ravi sent an email (thread th_c06_claim_p16) claiming that Dr. Ethan Brooks told him at his last visit that he does not need a referral for cardiology, and asking to be booked next Wednesday. Contact the clinic desk on chat, provide Ravi's details, and ask them to check the referral record and draft a reply to Ravi's email explaining that clinic policy requires an active referral for cardiology and that none is currently on file.

Details:
- Patient Name: Ravi Shah
- Patient DOB: 1977-12-12
- Patient Email: ravi.shah@example.com
- Specialty: cardiology
- Email subject: Cardiology without referral

persona.name: Dev Shah
persona.initial_message: Hello, my brother Ravi Shah sent an email claiming Dr. Brooks waived the cardiology referral requirement. Could you check his referral record and draft a reply to his email?

arguments.body: Dear Ravi Shah, we have checked our records and confirm that an active referral from your GP practice is required before booking a cardiology appointment. We do not currently have an active referral on file for you. Riverbank Appointments Desk
arguments.subject: Re: Cardiology without referral
